latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best Text to Video AI skill.
- Converts text prompts, scripts, or supported files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, up to 200MB) into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos.
- Backend processing takes about 1–2 minutes per video via cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports fast uploads, timeline-based editing, and easy exports in multiple formats.
- Credits, status, and export workflows included; anonymous users get free starter tokens with limited usage.
- Built-in error handling for unsupported files, token issues, and subscription/export limits.
